rows.Open question: Do website terms and robots signals (LHC, SHC, SC, BHC) bind reuse that s.57(1)(q) permits? Does s.57(1)(q)(ii) cover adaptation (translation, AI summaries)? Does s.376A PPC have a superior-court Explanation like JJSA s.13? Are consolidated portal texts (not Gazette prints) covered by s.57(1)(q)(i)? Has s.57 been amended since 2000 (the Pakistan Code PDF matches the quoted text, but amendment history was not traced)?

When and by what instrument were LHC, SHC, PHC and SC neutral citations introduced? Are non-AFR LHC PDFs at predictable URLs (deliberately not probed)? Total counts and earliest years for IHC, SC and SHC (including former judges)? Share of scanned PDFs per court (samples of 1–3 only)? Are any court orders restricting publication flagged anywhere machine-readably?
Provincial service tribunals, AJK/GB service tribunals, banking, consumer and environmental forums: not covered or shallowly searched. No standalone CAT website found.

Legal status of KP merged-district Continuation Acts 2018/2019; list of federal laws extended to GB or the merged districts; whether the AJK Interim Constitution PDF includes all amendments; KP Code disclaimer text; GB Order 2018's current constitutional status.

D1 record count and duplicate rate; D3 source of 3,478 chat rows and the LEGAL-UQA licence; how many records in the federal sibling ipfs_pakistan_laws came from Common Crawl; content of Zenodo 21671415.
Stage of the Personal Data Protection Bill; family-court confidentiality rules; provincial child-protection media bars (e.g. KP 2010 Act).
